name: code-kinds-e2e-fixture-generic-json-and-count-pin
body: The accessor e2e fixture is a real database: a hermetic scan of a scratch repo whose payload declares a module, a file, a struct and a function, and `PreviousScan::capture` reads the recorded kinds from that `db.lbug` — the test writes and parses no `graph.jsonl`. The count pin is the set of distinct recorded kinds, which must equal exactly `module`/`file`/`struct`/`function`. Limits: the payload lines are hand-written and the kind set is a hard-coded pin. Upgrade by extending the fixture if the capture starts reading additional fields, and revisit the pin if the four Implementation kinds grow.
